items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I never did meet him. ... Tommy Morris, I never met him! I never met him.

ctx.x: Oh, that's before my time. Ernest Elliott. I don't know him. I never did meet him. But when you say Tommy Morris... That's before I come to New York. I was up in Boston and I ran across some of Tommy Morris' records, some of the records he had. When I was listening at 'em, I was very impressed with the records, and I always wanted to meet Tommy Morris. His records, they really impressed me; you know, them old records.
Sidney Bechet was on some of them.
